strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hmm... this is the spot. Where we joined Kamille and Captain Amuro...
Around here? Where that Federation transport went missing?
No doubt about it. ...Hm! What's that?
When we joined up with Captain Amuro and Kamille before,
there wasn't anything like that here...
What's going on?
...Kukuku, waltzing right in...
Isn't that way too obviously suspicious...?
It's awfully blatant, isn't it...
...Don't tell me, a secret ninja base!?
Nah, no way.
Why don't you give it up already?
Knock it off, Lenny. You're not Princess Romina.
Well, let's head out for now.
Looks like there's a chance we'll find that transport.
No response on comms!
All right, we don't know what's in there.
Everyone, be careful as you investigate that mountain base!
No reaction, it seems.
...I've got a bad feeling, though.
Hmm, I wonder.
What!?
Wh-What is this...?
A Meganoid machine...! So the one behind these disappearances is...!
Ufufu... Hyaahahaha! Another state-of-the-art mech for me!
My collection must grow richer by the day!
A Megaborg, just as I thought...!
Now this is a big catch,
the Gandor Team that Mylene was talking about!
So he wasn't lying in wait for us...?
Kukuku, oh, that dragon-shaped battleship is nice too.
And there's more, so many more... Fufufu, beautiful.
How lowly humans can build such things is a total mystery.
...And who was it that built you...?
What's that? I see, so you're...
You scoundrel, hoarding the latest mechs just to sate your greed,
If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun... come and get me!
Daitarn 3... b-beautiful...
Hey, Banjo! I don't think he's listening!?
B-Beautifuuul! This is the pinnacle of mechanical beauty!
I want it! I must have it! Come on, Soldiers, get him!
Capture it without a scratch!
What a joke! Then feast your eyes on Mazinger Z's beauty too!
Heh, interesting...! Let's show him Great's beauty and strength!
Bah! Useless Soldiers! Then from my collection...!
That's... a Zeon mobile suit!? But why!?
And a Gaizok one too...!
Behold my heavy-firepower series!
Go! My Benmel Collection!
There's plenty more in my collection! Next up is this!
Aura Battlers!? How did he get those...
And those belong to the Titans!?
I nabbed those fellows who suddenly showed up the other day!
Such beautiful forms!
Heh, Aura Battlers ain't about looks, it's skill... Watch this...!
Show yourself, Meganoid Commander!
No need to rush, that was my plan! Banjo, prepare yourself!
Tobikage!? Now that's a welcome sight!
Tobikage!
Insolent! A single reinforcement won't... Wuooooh!?
Huh!? Did Tobikage already attack?
Hey, hey... don't tell me.
Wh-What is this! Incredible! Softness and strength, wabi and sabi,
united in perfect Oriental magic!
A Japanese ninja robot! It must join my collection, no matter what!!
Tobikage!
Insolent! A single reinforcement won't... Wuooooh!?
Huh!? Did Tobikage already attack?
Hey, hey... don't tell me.
Wh-What is this! Incredible! Softness and strength, wabi and sabi,
united in perfect Oriental magic!
A Japanese ninja robot! It must join my collection, no matter what!!
That bastard... Tobikage! Get him!
Grr! Mmm, it's so rare I hated to bring it out... Bah!
What's that!?
An old-model mobile suit...?
RX-78-3, the G-3 Gundam...! That's in his collection too... and
A Zaku S-type! I-I want to pilot it...
Hyaahahaha! It's been heavily modified!
Taste the power of rare One Year War relics!
That Gundam... I wonder if we could get our hands on it...
The Gundam, Colonel Char's Zaku... Wreck just the generators...
I see! I like it. I don't know if it'll work, though...
Nuooh, I underestimated you...!
But Banjo Haran, don't think this is over...!
I don't intend to let it end either...!
You Meganoids... I'll crush every last one of you!
Don't you forget it...!
Silence! I'll have my revenge! For my collection, too!
What on earth was that Meganoid all about?
That was quite a commotion.
Man, I'm beat.
What a commotion that was, Tetsuya.
He threw me off my game the whole time.
First the Teleport Machine incident, and now this Benmel...
The Meganoids have grown quite active of late, Master Banjo.
They never learn, still talking about making humanity Meganoids...
Banjo... are you okay?
Yeah. He was a clown... but that's not the point.
The Meganoids... are definitely making a comeback...!
Still no change in the situation... huh.
No use worrying, Commander. Let's recover the stolen supplies.
You're right. All right, everyone, enter the base
and get to work recovering the stolen supplies.
